'''Tim Guzman Mega Tournament II in Huntington Beach California (tournament report)''' is [[Tim Guzman]]'s Day 1 report on [[Huntington Beach Mega Tournament II]]. He published it on [[The Outer Rim (fan site)|The Outer Rim]] as The Information Broker.<ref name="mega">[https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Megatournament2.htm Mega Tournament II in Huntington Beach California], The Outer Rim (The Information Broker). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261029234227/https://www.geocities.ws/ev9d11/TheOuterRim/Articles/Megatournament2.htm Internet Archive]</ref> He finished 1st at 14 (+120) with [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|Hunt Down]] and Mains and Toys. The first-place prize was six uncut Limited Premiere sheets.

== Original report ==

<blockquote>
<div style="white-space:pre-wrap; font-family:inherit"><nowiki>
Title: Mega
 Tournament II in Huntington Beach California

 This tournament was one you can not
 miss out on. When we saw the promotion for it on Decipher's site for the first
 time. We knew we had to go. Day 1 on Saturday the first place prize was 6 UNCUT
 Limited Premiere Sheets. Plus the top eight also gets great looking trophy's.
 Day 2 was the team event where there was a special Team trophy plus each team
 member gets a trophy. Not to mention the winning team has some bragging rights.
 With this before us, and the fact it was being held only in California a group
 form here, Las Vegas, Nevada, decided to go. We started with 5 people going
 to go, to only 3 going. We were a little concerned playing with only 3 Team
 members during the Team event. But we thought we were ready anyway.

 It was Chris Hines, Ted Hansen, and myself(Tim Guzman), who went to the Mega
 Tournament. We woke up Saturday morning around 4:00 AM. And hit the rode at
 about 5:00 AM to be there on time. We were tired, but we felt ready(as long
 as we didn't eat meat, you had to be there). The performance of all three of
 us was excellent. Both days we left that place making sure they will not forget
 about the 'Vegas Stike Team'. This report will only be on the games I did on
 Day 1. I will say how Ted and Chris did as far as their ranking, but of course
 I can not do a Game by game play for them. Aereport on Day 2 will follow this
 one.

 This is the day. The day for the 6 UNCUT sheets of Limited Premiere for whoever
 comes in first!! We knew it was going to be tough this day when we showed up.
 There was a lot of tough players there and there was 8 GAMES to play. So it
 wasn't going to be easy. Here is what I faced to come in FIRST PLACE. Yes that
 is right I now have the coveted 6 uncut sheets. I do not have a deck listing
 with this report, but I will post the Decks I played in a couple of days so
 check back. Just so you know, my Dark was Hunt Down and my Light had Mains and
 Toys.

 Game 1

 My Dark Side vs Nick Boll's All around deck His Rating 1500

 It was this kids first tournament and he had Attack Run in his deck. So that
 pretty much says what happened in this game. I was being as nice as possible
 showing him many things on what to do in the game. Nice kid he will catch on
 quick I am sure of it. Ted and Chris both won Game 1 also.

 Full Win by 39 Total: 2(+39)

 Highlights: Nothing really much to say accept that was on game down.

 Lowlights: Being really tired from lack of sleep. I should be getting my second
 wind soon.

 Game 2

 My Light Side vs Travis Frazier? Musician Deck...rating:1902

 This deck is a fun deck to play it has basically mains in it. I was ready for
 anything this person could throw at me. He started with Tatooine Jabba Palace
 and Expand the Empire. At first I was thinking he was playing a manipulator
 deck so I started with Scramble Transmission. Boy was I wrong. He was playing
 Dark side Musicians Deck. I found out a little too late. In fact even now I
 can not believe I lost so bad to this deck. No offense Travis, you definitely
 beat me out right, and you caught me by surprise with that beat douwn. But still
 musicians? I have Leia and EPP Han together against a few of those musicians.
 I had no worries, then all of the sudden he has this character who can move
 one person away depending on how many Musicians he has at the site. So he moved
 Leia away and Han was only against Massive power guys. I had no Houjix in my
 hand :( I had to lose Han plus 24 cards. Game over.

 Full Loss by 30 Total: 2(+9)

 Highlights: Ummm nothing...oh wait I got my one loss out of the eay. That was
 me being optimistic.

 Lowlights: Losing by 30 really brought me down. I didn't think I had a chance
 after this , but...

 Game 3

 My Light Side Vs Ross Touriel's Hunt Down...Rating 1448

 Ross was a young kid around 11 years old. But he knew his stuff. I have never
 seen anyone so young yet play so well. I was losing from Visage the whole game.
 He also had a steady drain of 4 going. I have a pretty bad draaw to start, but
 soon I was able to stop one of the drains with of Course Epp's. When I was ready
 I drop Obi-Wan down and I knew he was going to Duel him. I was able to win the
 duel so that sealed my victory.

 Full Win by 16? Total: 4(+25)

 Highlights: Winning in a duel against Vader.

 Lowlights: Suffering from Visage the whole game.

 Game 4

 My Dark Vs James Lafferty's Droid+Plans+Inserts...Rating 1983

 I had Vader at his Y4 Throne room draining for 4 with presence on turn 2. He
 had 2 droids deployed with a numbers in my deck by turn 2 also. I had a Torture
 for the first number card and was forced to use it after I activated the very
 next turn. After that I set up a ship in space so I won't need to activate anymore.
 But somehow he gets another number card in and I don't have any Tortures in
 hand. I am thinking I won't run into the cards with a small acivation, but I
 do after only 5 cards. I take a 7 card damage, but no more. After that I always
 had a Torture in my hand. I had visage working the whole game and was draining
 for a total of 8. I altar his DSP so I make sure he isn't able to come back
 in the game. He did kill one of my Vader's with a Epp Hit Squad, but I was able
 to deploy another. I was about to Duel Luke when He deployed him, but I knew
 he had some really high Destiny Draws in his deck.

 Full Win by 17? Total: 6(+42)

 Highlights: Winning against a good Numbers deck and a good player.

 Lowlights: Losing 7 cards from an Epp Hit squad and losing 7 cards from an insert.

 Game 5

 My Light Side Vs I think Bottomley was his name ISB...Rating: 1748

 He was playing his game really good. I was a little worried about making a mistake
 with Obe. I force with him and he made him missing. So he was missing the whole
 game which kind of sucked. He was also force draining in space and was using
 his ISB's for blocking drains with Undercover. When I finally found some of
 my ships I was able to do something about it. It was a long drawn out battle.
 Ever time I get a good force drain going he would put another one Undercover.
 I was able to kell one undercover spy and take control of space. This game could
 have gone either way.

 Full Win by 7 Total: 8(+49)

 Highlights: I finished this game 30 seconds before time was called.

 Lowlights: Nothing really it was a fun game.

 Game 6

 My Dark Side Vs Purinton?'s Cloud City Mains...Rating 1605

 He was able to cancel Visage pretty early in this game. But soon I got another
 Visage out. He wasn't going to give up so he deploys a spy and someone else
 to cancel my second Visage. By now Vader was on Cloud city and some of my ships
 were in space draining. I could have deploy someone to take care of the guys
 he used to Cancel my Visage but for some reason I never did. Soon He deploys
 SOS so I make my way over to where he is at and tell him to go. During his Control
 phase I disarm Luke. He is a little upset about that. Now he deploys Savrip
 and Epp Han at that site. I wait until he starts a battle then I duel Luke and
 win he turns him to the dark side then I altar savrip I slice up Han and he
 loses somewhere around 10-15 more cards. Pretty much game over right there.
 After the game he wanted to count my deck, to make sure I had 60 cards in it.
 Of course I did, but I was a little shock he thought I was Cheating.

 Full Win by 26 Total: 10(+77)

 Highlights: Turning Luke to the dark side. You got to love that.

 Lowlights: Having Visage cancelled twice. Other than that this was cool.

 Game 7

 My Dark side Vs Ted Hansen's Light Side Space Numbers...rating:1870

 His deck is a mean deck. I had a pretty good advantage in this game, because
 Ted is a buddy of mine and I knew his Deck pretty well. Well come to think of
 it he knew my deck pretty well also. :) He had a god draw, but I too had a god
 draw. Things were just going good for me during this game. I stopped his space
 drains and had a torture in my hand every time he tried to insert on me. He
 has two Transmission Terminated in his deck, but it never came up so I hit him
 with Visage the whole game.

 Full Win by 26 Total: 12(+103)

 Highlights: Not losing to a numbers deck, and I only had one more game to go.

 Lowlights: Not many accept having to play against someone you drove up with.
 Of course facing him in game 7 is nothing to complain about.

 Game 8

 My Light Side Vs Eric Bruen's ISB...Rating 1904

 I knew this game was going to be tough. Eric was the one who came in first during
 the last Mega Tournament. I played pretty cautiously. During one battle I clashed
 the wrong guy, I thought I had him. But this character, if lost, will satisfy
 all attrition and battle damage against you. I did a lttle damage here and there
 without him doing much damage to me. Except making Luke lost after a force drain.
 At one point I thought Leia was going to get a beat down, but I survive with
 just the right draw. After a while I knew I was going to win. He knew it too,
 but wanted to keep the differential low.

 Full Win by 17 Total: 14(+120)

 Highlights: WOW I did it. I fell great after this game. I can't get this smile
 off of my face.

 Lowlights: You have got to be kidding me, there is NONE.

 I checked out all of the UNCUT sheets. It only has 3 flaws, but the Rare Sheets
 are perfect. What a great prize. Plus the Trophy that says Grand Champion looks
 great two. Ted and Chris both also get Trophies of their own, with Ted coming
 in 3rd and Chris coming 7th. What a good day for Las Vegas. I will try to get
 a report on the Team event soon. But now I will tell everyone that the " Vegas
 Strike Team' came in first place. That is right everyone we as a Team did a
 SWEEP fo the two day Tournament. I guess you can say we blew Alderaan up :)

 Here is the Top Eight:

 1 Tim Guzman Las Vegas, NV 14 (+120)

 2 Clayton Atkin Modesto, CA 12 (+86)

 3 Ted Hansen Layton, UT 12 (+74)

 4 Ben Robinson Costa Mesa, CA 12 (+67)

 5 Eric "Uncle Buck" Bruen Sunland, CA 12 (+57)

 6 Tom Mascari Spring Valley, CA 10 (+82)

 7 Chris Hines Las Vegas, NV 10 (+67)

 8 Dan Lujan La Puente, CA 10 (+48)
</nowiki></div>
</blockquote>
